write_up: You've taught math at Lake Travis High School and KIPP Austin, and your resume shows you moving toward data analytics through training and projects. I read it for Mathematics Teacher because that's your most recent title, though the projects point in another direction. A recruiter can follow the teaching work, but the analytics job you want isn't named.

The Student Performance Dashboard is a strong model: you name Excel, the measures you tracked and the time covered. The next line also says the math department used it to decide which units needed re-teaching. Your housing project is relevant to the transition, but it sits below the teaching roles.

Let's name the analytics job you're targeting and bring the projects closer to the top when you apply for it. Then start with the assessment and benchmark work at Lake Travis: add what you found and how you used it, where you can.
